_howto: Add a new entry to 'messages' each day. Copy a whole { ... } block, paste it, change the date and text. Every block needs a comma after it EXCEPT the last one. Keep the ] and } at the bottom.

messages.text: Saint Angelina of Serbia fun fact: Saint ANgelina of Serbia was actually an albanian woman born in southern Albania but passed away in Vojvodina. Angelina sister was married to Skenderbeg. And Saint Angelina met her husband (Serbian guy) when she was visiting her sister is Skarar (then montenegrin town), and her husband also came to visit Skenderbeg.
